recentChanges.title: GTE assessment criteria tightened
recentChanges.description: DIBP issued updated guidance on Genuine Temporary Entrant assessment. Increased scrutiny on applicants with immediate family members already in Australia on any visa subclass.

recentChanges.title: Processing times extended to 34 days average
recentChanges.description: Department confirms increased caseload for Q1 2026 resulting in extended processing. Offshore applications for India source market averaging 41 days.

recentChanges.title: Financial evidence threshold updated
recentChanges.description: Minimum financial evidence requirement updated to AUD 21,041 for 12-month course. Previously AUD 20,290. Agents must update client checklists.

recentChanges.title: SDS stream refusal rate reaches 56% for Indian applicants
recentChanges.description: IRCC data confirms SDS refusal rate for India origin applicants at 56% in April 2026, up from 48% in March. Financial documentation insufficiency cited as primary refusal reason in 61% of cases.

recentChanges.title: IRCC introduces enhanced study plan review
recentChanges.description: New mandatory structured study plan template introduced. Officers instructed to assess return intent more rigorously. Applications without clear post-graduation return plan facing higher refusal rates.

recentChanges.title: International student cap extended to 2027
recentChanges.description: IRCC confirms the international student intake cap for designated learning institutions will continue through 2027. Province-level allocations published — Ontario and BC most restricted.

recentChanges.title: INZ reduces average processing to 28 days
recentChanges.description: Immigration New Zealand reports processing time improvement following system upgrade. Average now 28 days, down from 35 days in Q4 2025. Online applications prioritised.

recentChanges.title: Post-study work right extended to 3 years
recentChanges.description: NZ government announces extension of post-study work rights from 2 to 3 years for graduates of NZ universities. Effective from 1 July 2026. Expected to increase NZ attractiveness vs Australia.

recentChanges.title: UKVI tightens financial maintenance requirements
recentChanges.description: Financial maintenance requirement increased to £1,334/month for London-based study (up from £1,265). Outside London increased to £1,023/month. 28-day bank statement rule strictly enforced.

recentChanges.title: Sri Lanka and Nepal refusal rates elevated
recentChanges.description: UKVI data shows elevated refusal rates for Sri Lanka (31%) and Nepal (28%) origin applicants in Q1 2026. Financial evidence cited as primary reason. Agents advised to ensure maintenance requirements comfortably exceeded.

recentChanges.title: Graduate visa review outcome — no changes
recentChanges.description: Home Office confirms Graduate visa (2 year post-study work) will remain unchanged despite calls for reduction. Positive signal for UK as study destination.
